packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once CI is green
Major updates always get a human look
@changesets/cli 3.x requires yarn >= 4.5.2 and this repo is on yarn 1 classic, so 3.x cannot be installed. Drop this rule when the repo moves to yarn 4.

changesets/action v2 renames every input this repo passes (version -> version-script, publish -> publish-script, commit -> commit-message, title -> pr-title), stops reading GITHUB_TOKEN from the environment in favour of a github-token input, and expects @changesets/cli 3.x, which is itself blocked by yarn 1. Adopt it together with the yarn 4 migration, updating .github/workflows/release.yml in the same change.

Babel 8 requires node ^22.18.0 || >=24.11.0, which drops the Node 20 row of the CI matrix, and jest 30's babel-jest still declares a peer dependency on @babel/core ^7. Lift this once Node 20 is out of the matrix and babel-jest supports 8.

typedoc 0.28 declares a typescript peer range topping out at 6.0.x and crashes on TypeScript 7 with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'PropertyDeclaration')". Lift this when typedoc supports TypeScript 7.
